turns.user: I don't know, it's over our budget
turns.mockReply: CORE includes one mine, a hike, lodging and four meals; for two it comes to $950,000 COP. Would you like to compare what each one covers?
CORE has one mine and the hike; PRIME adds a second mine and horseback riding. Which scope suits you better?
We can look at an option that fits you better. Are you looking to reduce the budget or the length of the trip?

turns.user: ok and do you have any day trip?
turns.mockReply: Yes, BASIC is the day trip: one mine, a hike, breakfast and lunch, with no overnight stay. Does coming back the same day work for you?
